summary: Only low lower-stands views exist; best is a 2024 dusk game-day shot with the field in the lower-middle. No elevated upper-deck view on Commons.

files.note: Low elevation, lower-stands sideline view across to the far (press box) side at dusk, 2024 game day; field rows ~1000-1600 of 1800 (55-88%), far stands rows ~650-1000, sky in the top ~35%; spectators in the bottom ~12%. Low viewpoint: field sits low in the frame

closest_misses.why: 2024 night, same low lower-stands viewpoint after a field rush: field covered by people, strong light glare in the top 40%, a fan in the foreground
2015 empty stadium from a concourse at field level behind a railing; railing fills the bottom, sky the top
